# Version 4.150.4
> **Text and stencil correctness** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects GPU glyph and stencil tracking and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU atlas and stencil tracking** — Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from treating evicted glyphs as current, and tracks shared stencil clears correctly across differing surface origins. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113), [#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
- **Windows HarfBuzz passes BA2007** — Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5123](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5123))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.4

The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.
